text:
Priya R.: hey all, excited to join today! quick blocker: Okta lets me start SSO but after I approve the MFA push my laptop (company-provided MacBook) sits on a spinner and then I get 'device not compliant' when accessing Drive. 1Password says 'account pending' too. anyone seen this with MDM?
Jon (IT): welcome Priya! :wave: send your corporate asset tag and confirm if you're on the corporate Wi‑Fi or home network. Device compliance usually fails if MDM hasn't pushed the cert or SSO profile.
Priya R.: asset tag MBP-1783, on home wifi but vpn off. I can still sign in to Slack and GH web, only Okta apps are failing.
Device Bot: Device MBP-1783 reported MDM status: enrolled, last check-in 2026-01-12T08:02:11Z, missing profile: okta-device-cert, OS version: macOS 14.2
Jon (IT): looks like the okta-device-cert didn't install. Can you open SelfService.app (company MDM) and run 'Apply okta cert' under 'Onboarding'?
Priya R.: SelfService shows error 'Profile install failed: policy requires user to accept Screen Recording permission' — that's weird, why would that block cert?
Alicia H.: fyi we had a recent MDM policy update that bundles a diagnostics profile which requests Screen Recording permission for advanced telemetry. Some macOS flows block other profile installs until the permission dialog is handled.
Jon (IT): try System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Screen Recording and grant the permission to SelfService. Then re-run the profile install. If that still fails, we'll push the cert from the MDM console.
Priya R.: gave permission to SelfService, retried, got 'Profile applied' ✅. Okta now prompts for push, I approved but still get 'device not compliant'.
Support Bot: Okta logs for priya.r@redwood.com: MFA success; device compliance check failed: missing 'encryption' requirement (FileVault).
Jon (IT): ah, FileVault isn't turned on. We require FileVault enabled for device compliance. Please enable FileVault in System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> FileVault, then reboot.
Priya R.: enabling FileVault now (encrypting in background). Rebooted. Okta SSO succeeded and Drive opens. 1Password still pending assignment though.
Alicia H.: 1Password is assigned via our HR->SCIM workflow; sometimes assignments lag until the first successful device compliance check. I can force-assign it from the admin console.
Alicia H.: assigned 1Password to priya.r@redwood.com. You should get an invite link in your inbox.
Priya R.: got the 1Password invite and SSO worked. enrolled MFA with push + Backup SMS. All set. Thanks everyone :tada:
Jon (IT): great — I'll mark the device as compliant in the asset tracker and close the onboarding ticket. If you need repo access or infra perms, ping @Alicia and @dev-leads.
Priya R.: will do. one last Q: where's the onboarding checklist? I couldn't access eng/onboarding earlier but can now.
Alicia H.: link shared in DM. Welcome aboard again! :sparkles:
